structure.structure_en: Living room, rectangular, deeper than wide, 3.6 m x 4.8 m; ceiling 2.7 m; floor: warm honey-toned wood planks laid lengthwise toward the far corner, continuous single-level plane, no steps. Front-left floor-to-ceiling window/balcony door behind curtains 2.8 x 2.4 m, sill 0 m, 50% along the wall. Camera 1.5 m high, 4 m to the far wall, 24 mm lens, tilt -5 degrees, horizon 45% of frame height. The number of openings is exactly 1; do not add or remove any opening. Fixed features that stay: skirting board: low painted skirting along base of walls; wall-mounted air-conditioner: split AC indoor unit high on the right wall near the corner; distribution box: recessed electrical panel with cover high on right wall; weak-current box: small recessed low-voltage panel low on right wall; ceiling light fitting: flush round ceiling-mounted fixture.
structure.structure_en_model: The living room is a rectangular single-level space, deeper than wide, with a flat plain white ceiling at about 2.7 m and no beams or dropped sections. Walls are flat white painted planes meeting at a front-left corner, finished with low skirting at the floor. The floor is a continuous plane of warm wood planks laid lengthwise toward that corner, with no level changes. The front-left wall carries a full-height glazed window or balcony door, currently hidden behind sheer and side curtains on a ceiling track. The long right wall is solid, hosting a high wall-mounted split air-conditioner, a recessed distribution panel and a lower weak-current box. The camera sits at 1.5 m in two-point perspective angled to the corner.
